name: structural-scanner
body: The bundled scanner artifact that graphs the structural formats: one self-contained Rust crate (`src/structlib`, absorbing `src/mdlib`) building one binary (`structfrontend`), shipped in the base apg package rather than as a per-format formula. It claims the files outside every code frontend's claim, runs with zero scan-time dependencies, and carries zero language-version ceiling; it is distinct from the per-language code frontends in `domain.entity.frontend-artifact`.
